title: How Much Home You Can ACTUALLY Afford In Texas (By Salary)
description:
Buying or Selling a Home ANYWHERE in Texas? Let's Talk! We Can Help. https://calendly.com/realestatestephen/30min?month=2024-07

Wondering how much house you can actually afford in Texas? In this video, we break down the real income needed to buy a home in major Texas cities — including Austin, San Antonio, Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, El Paso, and Killeen–Fort Cavazos. Using the 30% rule (your monthly housing payment = 30% of your take-home pay), I show you how much you need to earn to comfortably afford a home with either 20% down or just 3.5% down.

⚠️ Spoiler: $50K ain’t cutting it in Austin…

Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer, military family, or just planning your move, this guide gives you a realistic, no-fluff look at Texas home affordability in 2025.
